WITH base_data AS ( SELECT * FROM biz_im_lk create_time &gt;= #{dto.startDate} and create_time &lt;= #{dto.endDate} and customer_id = #{dto.customerId} ) SELECT a.dayTime, a.customer_id, a.customer_name, a.influcerCount, c.totalRecordCount, c.influcerRecordCount, cooperationCount, todoLinkCount, orderedCount, satisfiedCount, unSatisfiedCount FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(a.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') dayTime, customer_id, customer_name, count(DISTINCT a.inflc_id) influcerCount, sum(CASE zixun_status WHEN 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) todoLinkCount FROM base_data a WHERE 1 = 1 GROUP BY dayTime, customer_id, customer_name ) a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT dayTime, customer_id, customer_name, sum(cooperation) cooperationCount FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') dayTime, customer_id, customer_name, inflc_id, max(cooperation) cooperation FROM base_data GROUP BY dayTime, customer_id, customer_name, inflc_id ) c GROUP BY dayTime, customer_id, customer_name ) b ON a.dayTime = b.dayTime AND a.customer_id = b.customer_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') dayTime, customer_id, customer_name, count(1) totalRecordCount, sum(CASE msg_fangxiang WHEN 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) influcerRecordCount FROM biz_im_record create_time &gt;= #{dto.startDate} and create_time &lt;= #{dto.endDate} and customer_id = #{dto.customerId} GROUP BY dayTime, customer_id, customer_name ) c ON a.dayTime = c.dayTime AND a.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') dayTime, customer_id, customer_name, count(1) orderedCount FROM biz_workorder WHERE quest_status = 3 and create_time &gt;= #{dto.startDate} and create_time &lt;= #{dto.endDate} and customer_id = #{dto.customerId} GROUP BY dayTime, customer_id, customer_name ) d ON a.dayTime = d.dayTime AND a.customer_id = d.customer_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') dayTime, customer_id, customer_name, sum(satisfied) satisfiedCount, sum(CASE satisfied WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) unSatisfiedCount FROM (SELECT id, customer_id, customer_name FROM base_data) b LEFT JOIN biz_im_lk_evaluate a ON a.lk_id = b.id create_time &gt;= #{dto.startDate} and create_time &lt;= #{dto.endDate} and customer_id = #{dto.customerId} GROUP BY dayTime, customer_id, customer_name ) e ON a.dayTime = e.dayTime AND a.customer_id = e.customer_id ORDER BY a.dayTime desc, a.customer_id, a.customer_name

sio.company_talent_ratio) compCommissionRate, bip.inflcplatid inflcplatid, bip.nick_platid nickPlatid , null as fail_reason, 1 as match_status FROM (settle_influencer_order sio , settle_projects sp , biz_influcer bi , settle_batch sb) LEFT join biz_influcer_project bip on bip.project_id = sp.parent_id and bip.influcer_id = sio.influencer_id WHERE sp.id = sio.project_id and bi.id = sio.influencer_id and sb.batch_no = sio.settlement_batch and sio.settlement_batch = #{batchNo} and sp.parent_id = #{mainProjectId} and sp.id = #{sonProjectId} and sio.influencer_name like concat('%',#{nickname},'%') and sio.influencer_id like concat('%',#{influencerId},'%') and sio.phone_number like concat('%',#{influencerPhone},'%') and sio.company_talent_ratio = #{infCommissionRate} and (bip.nick_platid like concat('%',#{platNickOrId},'%') or bip.inflcplatid like concat('%',#{platNickOrId},'%')) UNION ALL SELECT 0 as id, siao.influencer_id influencer_id, siao.project_id sonProjectId, siao.batch_no settleBatchNo, siao.amount incomeAmount, 0 as payableAmount, 0 as withdrawAmount, 0 as unWithdrawAmount, bi.nike_name nickname, bi.login_tel phone, sb.zhouqi_end zhouqiEnd, sb.zhouqi_start zhouqiStart, siao.company_talent_ratio infCommissionRate, null as infl_status, null as infl_status_name, (100 - **queryTotalCount**

```sql
WITH base_data AS ( SELECT * FROM biz_im_lk create_time &gt;= #{dto.startDate} and create_time &lt;= #{dto.endDate} ) SELECT a.dayTime, a.influcerCount, c.totalRecordCount, c.influcerRecordCount, cooperationCount, todoLinkCount, orderedCount, satisfiedCount, unSatisfiedCount FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(a.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') dayTime, count(DISTINCT a.inflc_id) influcerCount, sum(CASE zixun_status WHEN 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) todoLinkCount FROM base_data a WHERE 1 = 1 GROUP BY dayTime ) a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT dayTime, sum(1) cooperationCount FROM (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') dayTime, inflc_id, max(cooperation) FROM base_data GROUP BY dayTime, inflc_id) b GROUP BY dayTime ) b ON a.dayTime = b.dayTime LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') dayTime, count(1) totalRecordCount, sum(CASE msg_fangxiang WHEN 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) influcerRecordCount FROM biz_im_record create_time &gt;= #{dto.startDate} and create_time &lt;= #{dto.endDate} GROUP BY dayTime ) c ON a.dayTime = c.dayTime LEFT JOIN (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') dayTime, count(1) orderedCount FROM biz_workorder WHERE quest_status = 3 GROUP BY dayTime) d ON a.dayTime = d.dayTime LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') dayTime, sum(satisfied) satisfiedCount, sum(CASE satisfied WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) unSatisfiedCount FROM (SELECT id, customer_id, customer_name FROM base_data) b LEFT JOIN biz_im_lk_evaluate a ON a.lk_id = b.id create_time &gt;= #{dto.startDate} and create_time &lt;= #{dto.endDate} GROUP BY dayTime ) e ON a.dayTime = e.dayTime ORDER BY a.dayTime DESC
```
